svg.title: Common format and forward-link capacity admission
svg.desc: Check endpoint capabilities, construct an aligned packet budget, compare it with 1.000 Gb/s MAC service and apply the selected admission policy.

div.style: color: rgb(81, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Proposed format, rate, channel count C and channel map

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Exact combination supported by both endpoints?

div.style: color: rgb(84, 32, 28) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Reject this combination; negotiate a supported configuration

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Group rate r = Fs for PCM; r = DSD bit rate / 32 for DSD

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Choose fixed G: 1 <= G <= floor(1440 / (4*C))

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Apply the selected packet assembly target; 125 us in the example budget

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Audio payload P = 4*C*G bytes; P <= 1440

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: One optional VLAN tag?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Tagged wire occupancy W = 42 + max(42, 12 + P) bytes

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Untagged wire occupancy W = 38 + max(46, 12 + P) bytes

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Packet rate = r/G; wire demand = 8*W*r/G bit/s

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Total forward demand fits the selected 1G admission policy?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Buffer, prefill, timing and clock arrangement supported?

div.style: color: rgb(22, 61, 37) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: OPEN may accept this immutable session context
